details:
For the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, our project 'RED PLANET NAVIGATOR' delivers a comprehensive 7-slide Martian Survival Guide.

How it works & Benefits: It serves as an actionable framework addressing the core challenges of interplanetary exploration and human survival on Mars. The guide covers the harsh Martian environment, historical exploration milestones, vital survival resources (water, oxygen, food, and energy management), and terraforming strategies to pave the way for sustainable multi-planetary habitation.

Tools & Development: The presentation was designed using Canva, supported by AI-assisted concept visuals and research-backed scientific strategies to ensure both aesthetic clarity and technical accuracy.
